git.commit_message: ci: Add GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline

footage_conditions: Synthetic daytime, 640x480, 25fps, car crops composited on road background
limitations: Person detection not validated (synthetic figures not detected by YOLO11n). Plate OCR not validated (no readable plates in synthetic car crops). Vehicle detection calibration shows 0 precision due to ground truth box-position mismatch. All metrics are DEMO STAGE — not WORKING until validated on held-out real footage with annotated persons and plates.
honesty_notes: All metrics are targets to measure, never published without documented tests.
Hardware, footage conditions, and sample size are recorded with every result.
Test records are append-only — never modify or delete historical records.
Human review mandatory — no automatic fines.
Stop time alone does NOT imply guilt.
